question: Will Ethereum's August 25 closing price be above $2,590 on CoinGecko?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if the ETH/USD price of Ethereum on CoinGecko is strictly above $2,590.00 at the market's settlement time on August 25, 2026 (UTC).
- "No": Wins if the ETH/USD price of Ethereum on CoinGecko is at or below $2,590.00 at the market's settlement time on August 25, 2026 (UTC).

Clarifications:
- The reference price is the CoinGecko ETH/USD spot price for Ethereum (coingecko.com/en/coins/ethereum) recorded at the market's settlement time on August 25, 2026 (UTC). If CoinGecko displays a daily closing price for August 25 (UTC), that value is used; otherwise the last available price at or before the settlement time is used.
